title: 'Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu' Gets Second Season in Fall 2026
content: An official website opened for the second season of Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu ( The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World ) anime series on Friday, revealing the returning cast, new staff, and a teaser visual (pictured).
author: MyAnimeList

title: Victoria of Many Faces Unveils New Trailer
content: Victoria of Many Faces anime unveiled a new trailer on Friday which features the ending theme song by KI_EN. The anime is slated to release this July. A visual and trailer were also revealed at AnimeJapan 2026 . Studio DEEN is animating with Nobukage Kimura as director.
author: Anime Corner

title: Manga 'Gekkakoku Kiiden' Gets TV Anime Adaptation
content: Production company Kadokawa announced a television anime adaptation of Tohru Himuka 's Gekkakoku Kiiden ( The Eccentric Doctor of the Moon Flower Kingdom ) manga on Friday, revealing the main cast, staff, teaser PV, and a celebratory illustration (pictured).

title: 'Buchigire Reijou wa Houfuku wo Chikaimashita.' Announces Additional Cast
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Metabo Hagure 's Buchigire Reijou wa Houfuku wo Chikaimashita. Madousho no Chikara de Sokoku wo Tatakitsubushimasu ( A Livid Lady's Guide to Getting Even: How I Crushed My Homeland with My Mighty Grimoires ) light novel announced additional cast on Friday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery Anime Movie Reveals New Trailer
content: The upcoming Made in Abyss: Awakening Mystery anime movie revealed a new trailer on Friday. Part 1 of the movie is set to premiere in Japan on October 23, 2026. The new film will serve as a direct continuation of the 2022 TV anime Made in Abyss: The Golden City of the Scorching Sun .
author: Anime Corner

title: The Eccentric Doctor of the Moon Flower Kingdom Manga Gets TV Anime
content: Kadokawa announced on Friday that a television anime of Tōru Himuka 's The Eccentric Doctor of the Moon Flower Kingdom manga has been green-lit. Himuka drew an illustration to celebrate the anime news: Koichiro Kuroda is directing the anime at Studio Elle , and Aki Suigetsu is in charge of the series scripts.
author: ANN

title: Inti Creates Announces Gunvolt Chronicles Luminous Avenger iX 3 Game
content: Inti Creates announced at the Bit Summit event on Friday it is developing the Gunvolt Chronicles Luminous Avenger iX 3 game for Nintendo Switch 2 and PC via Steam with a planned release in 2027.
author: ANN

title: Inti Creates' Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced Game Collection Heads to Switch 2 This Year With New Story Mode
content: Inti Creates announced at the Bit Summit event on Friday it will release Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced — a collection of polished and updated versions of its Azure Striker Gunvolt , Azure Striker Gunvolt 2 , and Azure Striker Gunvolt 3 games — this year for Nintendo Switch 2.
author: ANN
